title: [Issue]: season no longer created during initial scan
body:
### Please describe your bug

10.8.x and even the first few unstable builds of 10.9 would correct create the 'Season 1' when scanning, this no longer seems to be the case in 10.9.0 stable.

It might be related to https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin/pull/11472, as doing a replace all on the show seems to 'fix' the issue.

It's probably related to using nfo's to help with my anime shows as I follow the anidb naming (so no S#E#) but I provide an tvshow.nfo and episode.nfo (which set the correct season and episode)

**I'm OK with this being closed immediately as not supported, but this did work fine before without needing to do a 2nd replace all metadata. So I would consider this a regression. The NFO's used to be enough to get all the info jellyfin required**

Log attached of the scan that picks it up and 2nd scan with refresh that actually creates the season 1 entry.

### Reproduction Steps

1. add a new show to the file system
2. generate `tvshow.nfo` and `<episode filename>.nfo`
3. Dashboard -> Libraries -> <my library> -> ... -> Scan library, select "Scan for new and updates files"

The show gets added, it even finds the provided anidb and anilist IDs from tvshow.nfo and fetches metadata.
I can even play episode 1 from the show view (and after than the next unplayed ...) But I do not have an entry under season.

comments.body: @Shadowghost still happens: How it shows after a `scan all media`, doing more `scan all media` does not fix it. Next up episode is clickable and does play fine... Clicking `Season 1` on the next up episode detail... results in a spinner for ever. This results in these requests: My guess is f566f845fac6b981af5d9bea2170c995 is the season UUID it recorded for the episode but that somehow got trimmed immediately during the scan? I'm guessing perhaps because I have no season metadata provider setup... (My guess, as I rebuild my music library yesterday after some remarks on discord, and I notice similar behavior. Albums were not being linked under artists if there are no metadata providers enabled, but the albums and artists headers in the library showed the list of Artists and Albums, using only the data in the tags for the audio files, `Search for missing metadata` would fix it, as would enabling a arist and album level metadata provider) Here is what it looks like after a `Search for missing metadata` ... f566f845fac6b981af5d9bea2170c995 was indeed the season UUID and it now returns data.

Since I can also replicate it without ANY providers checked on a new test library... I had a peak at

and
https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin/blob/master/MediaBrowser.XbmcMetadata/Providers/EpisodeNfoProvider.cs

Which I believe are the default non-removable NFO parser/provider, they seem to at least fetch the season and episode numbers from the NFO
https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin/blob/31aa44d23d12b5dbb5f9a131242cc82c9ef98f24/MediaBrowser.XbmcMetadata/Parsers/EpisodeNfoParser.cs#L150-L163

https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin/blob/31aa44d23d12b5dbb5f9a131242cc82c9ef98f24/MediaBrowser.XbmcMetadata/Parsers/EpisodeNfoParser.cs#L187-L194

~~Which seems wrong to me, displayseason shouldn't have anything to do with airsbefore_season and we don't even consume displayseason in the case block. A bug could also be lurking here I guess.~~
Nevermind, this bit of code makes sense, we consume either of these as an Int, which is file. And displayseason sets in which season the episode should go not the display name of the season,.

I'm having a hard time wrapping my head around this code though, both `FetchDataFromXmlNode` and `Fetch` seem to be getting the episode number, but only the first one the season number. :|
